value_proposition: Independent IT vendor negotiation consulting and advisory that helps organisations reduce costs, limit contractual and compliance risk, strengthen commercial terms, and retain leverage in software, SaaS, cloud, managed-services, and other strategic technology supplier deals. The approach combines human judgment, claimed vendor-side experience, AI-informed analysis, tailored negotiation frameworks, and playbooks.
target_customers: Scaling companies without dedicated negotiation teams
Lean enterprise procurement and sourcing teams
Organisations facing high-value or higher-risk technology supplier negotiations
products_services: Technology vendor contract review and optimisation for software, SaaS, cloud, and other strategic IT agreements
Tailored technology negotiation frameworks and commercial playbooks
Contract negotiation support for proposals, renewals, cloud migrations, managed services, and strategic supplier deals
SaaS and cloud compliance dispute support
Vendor dispute mediation and backchannel assistance
Strategic vendor negotiation coaching and internal capability building
Strategic vendor deal management and end-to-end deal oversight
Fractional or embedded deal advisory across a portfolio of contracts
Discovery, contract assessment, leverage identification, framework design, scripts, tools, and execution support

Situation-specific negotiation frameworks and modular playbooks
Commercial contract, pricing, supplier-performance, and risk analysis
Use of commercial benchmarks, although benchmark sources and methodology are not disclosed
Vendor-side sales-playbook knowledge translated into buyer-side negotiation strategies

Negotiating enterprise software agreements and Oracle ULAs
Preparing for and negotiating SaaS and software renewals
Optimising cloud service agreements and cloud migrations
Identifying unused or outdated features and pricing inefficiencies
Finding hidden costs, restrictive clauses, lock-in provisions, and ambiguous terms
Challenging software licence audit findings and vendor compliance assertions

Mediating vendor disputes and providing discreet backchannel support
Building repeatable negotiation capability within procurement, legal, IT, finance, and leadership teams

Sector-specific supplier contract review is offered, but no specific customer industries are identified
business_model: Specialist professional-services and advisory model delivered through one-off/on-demand work, fixed-scope engagements, fractional or retainer access, embedded advisory, and performance-related structures.
pricing_model: Custom pricing by enquiry. Available structures include fixed fees, retainers or fractional advisory, and performance-related fees tied to measurable savings, avoided penalties, or recovered value. Contract-review pricing depends on the number of contracts, supplier complexity, and review depth. No public rates, minimum fees, or performance-fee percentages are disclosed.
deployment_model: Consulting and advisory engagements rather than a disclosed standalone software deployment

The overall offering is labelled Early Access (Beta), with an invitation to participate in a journey toward 'smarter negotiations in 2026'; the website does not clarify which components are beta versus currently generally available
